readingGuide: The page type a person reading each fixture would give it, decided from the page and not from the classifier. `page-type-corpus.test.ts` asserts the classifier agrees, using the URL the scan requested (the first redirect hop), as the orchestrator does. `live: true` fixtures are also fetched live by `page-type-live.test.ts`, which re-checks only the page type. `why` names the shape the fixture covers.

homepage-root-plain.why: A storefront served at `/` with no redirect.

homepage-root-canonical-locale.why: Served at `/`, canonical pointing at a locale root, 110 hreflang alternates.

homepage-redirect-locale-home.why: `/` redirects to a locale path ending in `home` (`/xx/home/`).

homepage-locale-root-hreflang.why: A locale root (`/xx/`) requested directly, with hreflang alternates naming its sibling roots.

category-collection-listing-schema.why: A storefront collection with listing schema and a collection URL.

category-grid-no-schema.why: A department page with a product grid, filters and pagination, and no listing schema.

category-filter-only.why: A category whose only listing evidence is pagination beside filters.

category-client-rendered.why: A category whose product grid is rendered by script; only the URL marks it.

category-listing-schema-grid.why: A themed listing with ItemList schema and a product grid.

product-productgroup-rail.why: A ProductGroup with two variants, an AggregateOffer on the group, and a recently-viewed carousel of product tiles.

product-microdata.why: Product and Offer in microdata only; og:type is `website`.

product-open-graph-only.why: og:type `product` and buy controls, no Product schema.

product-schema-no-open-graph.why: Product schema and buy controls, no og:type.

product-open-graph-schema.why: og:type `product` plus Product schema, with dated offers.

article-blog-post.why: A storefront blog post with og:type `article` and Article schema.

general-about-page.why: An about-us page: neither listing, product nor article.

general-faq.why: A help page carrying FAQPage schema.
